subject: Billing ownership swap + term addendum for renewal and capacity top-up
body:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@orbital.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, procurement@orbital.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Dec 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + capacity top-up — billing owner change + PO attached

Hi Lauren,

We’re moving the billing owner for our Redwood account from Orbital Labs LLC to Orbital Inc (consolidation across our legal entities). We’re at renewal and planning to add 50k tokens/month committed capacity on top of the existing plan. Procurement asked me to send a single PO that covers the renewal term and the top-up, and to also request a change to Net45 terms for this renewal (their new policy).

I attached a draft PO (Orbital_PO_Draft_2028-12-12.pdf). Our AP team will need your invoice to be issued to:

  - Payor: Orbital Inc
  - Tax ID / EIN: 12-3456789
  - Billing contact: ap_payables@orbital.ai, cc: oliver.chen@orbital.ai

They also asked for a W-9 and the Redwood invoice header to reflect Orbital Inc. Is it possible to:

  1) Update the billing entity on the renewal invoice and future invoices
  2) Accept the attached PO (we’ll sign it once you confirm the billing entity)
  3) Set Net45 for the renewal term (one-time change for this contract year)

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Elena
Director of Procurement
Orbital AI

---
Attachment: Orbital_PO_Draft_2028-12-12.pdf (application/pdf)

-----Original Message-----
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: elena.ramos@orbital.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Dec 2028 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal + capacity top-up — billing owner change + PO attached

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the note and the PO draft. This is doable but I need to confirm details with Finance and Sales Ops — two quick clarifications before we escalate the PO for signature:

  - Is the requested Net45 meant to apply for the full 12-month renewal or just the initial invoice?
  - Can you confirm whether Orbital Inc will be the contract counterparty (i.e., do you need a contract amendment to swap legal entity), or only the invoice/payor changes?

I’ll pull in Marcus (AM) and Grace (Finance) and we’ll come back with a timeline for the invoice header update and a DocuSign addendum if required.

I’ll aim to have an answer by end of day Wednesday PST.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Dec 2028 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Orbital — billing ownership swap + PO

Team — forwarding Orbital’s request. Quick notes:

  - We’re at renewal for Orbital (deal DEAL-ORB-2028-11). Client wants a 50k token/month committed add-on (upsell) + entity switch for billing.
  - Procurement asks for Net45 (they say company-wide policy).
  - Attached PO looks standard; they requested invoice to Orbital Inc with EIN 12-3456789.

Grace — can Finance accept Net45 for the renewal and make the invoice changes (billing entity + email to ap_payables@orbital.ai)? If we need a contract amendment to change the legal counterparty, we should flag Legal, but if it’s only an invoice/payor change we can proceed faster with an addendum for invoicing.

Vivek — can you confirm whether Sales Ops needs the PO uploaded to HubSpot and whether we should generate a seat/capacity addendum for the 50k top-up?

Thanks,
Marcus

-----Original Message-----
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 Dec 2028 08:09:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Orbital — billing ownership swap + PO

Thanks for the ping. A few items:

  1) Net45: Finance can approve Net45 for this renewal provided we have an approved credit memo and procurement contact verified. We’ll run a brief credit check; timeline is 2 business days.
  2) Billing entity vs contract counterparty: if the contracting entity remains Orbital Labs LLC and they only want invoices issued to Orbital Inc, we can support that (bill-to/payor change) without a contract amendment. If they want to change the legal counterparty on the contract, Legal involvement is required (longer timeline).
  3) We need a W-9 from Orbital Inc (they attached W9_Orbital_Inc_2028.pdf — good), and AP email for remittance (ap_payables@orbital.ai) on the PO. Also need the PO number populated before we generate an invoice.

Action items I’ll take: run credit check (ETA EOD Thursday), prepare invoice template with Orbital Inc header once PO is confirmed, and confirm whether we can accept Net45 for the first invoice or the entire term (prefers entire term but will confirm once we have credit results).

Grace O’Connor
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Dec 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Orbital — billing ownership swap + PO

Looping in Sales Ops intake: I uploaded the PO to HubSpot (link below) and created a capacity addendum draft for the 50k tokens/month top-up. The addendum is currently in draft; Marcus — please review the language around billing and make sure it aligns with Elena’s ask (bill-to = Orbital Inc). If client confirms only invoice/payor change, we can process the addendum without Legal.

HubSpot link: https://hubspot.redwood.example/deal/DEAL-ORB-2028-11/doc/PO-Upload-20281214
DocuSign draft link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?doc=orbital-addendum-202812

Vivek Kulkarni
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@orbital.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, procurement@orbital.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Dec 2028 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal + capacity top-up — billing owner change + PO attached

Hi Elena,

Quick update and next steps: thanks for the PO and W-9. Finance has provisionally approved Net45 for the renewal pending a short credit check (2 business days). We can issue invoices to Orbital Inc (bill-to/payor change) without amending the contract entity — that keeps the timeline short.

What we need from you now to finalize and issue the invoice + schedule the addendum for signature:

  1) Final PO with a PO number populated and the AP contact in the remit block (we can accept the draft but need the PO# to invoice).
  2) Confirmation that the requested Net45 applies to the full 12-month renewal (please reply to this thread).
  3) If you want the contract counterparty changed to Orbital Inc, please let us know — that will require Legal and take longer.

Once we have the PO# and confirmation on the Net45 scope, I’ll route the addendum to DocuSign and Finance will attach credit approval. Expect invoices to be issued to Orbital Inc and emailed to ap_payables@orbital.ai.

If you prefer a 20-minute call to close this, I’m available Monday morning PST.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

--
Related attachments referenced: Orbital_PO_Draft_2028-12-12.pdf, W9_Orbital_Inc_2028.pdf
